description: Adds a Clio calendar entry (court date, deadline, meeting), optionally linked to a matter. No attendees or invites. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

all_day.description: True for an all-day deadline. Defaults to false.

calendar_name.description: Clio calendar by exact name. Defaults to the firm's account calendar.

confirm.description: false or omitted returns a preview; true applies the change identified by preview_id.

end_at.description: Same format as start_at. For all_day, the LAST day of the entry (same as start_at for a one-day entry).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first result without a second write. Defaults to preview_id.

matter_id.description: Optional. Links the entry to this Clio matter.

preview_id.description: preview_id is the id returned by this tool's preview call. Required when confirm is true.

start_at.description: ISO-8601 with offset (2026-11-03T09:00:00-06:00), or YYYY-MM-DD when all_day.

name: create_calendar_event
title: Create Clio calendar entry
